faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Ordnance Factory Ambarnath LWO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form for the Labour Welfare Officer (LWO) position at Ordnance Factory Ambarnath is 03 October 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Labour Welfare Officer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Labour Welfare Officer (LWO) post will receive a fixed salary of Rs. 45,000 per month. This is a contractual position, and the salary is as per the terms of the contract.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the LWO position?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Labour Welfare Officer (LWO) post, candidates must possess a Degree from a recognized University/Institute. Additionally, they need a Postgraduate Degree/Diploma in Social Work, Social Science, Labour Welfare, Industrial Relations, Personnel Management, or an MBA in Personnel Management or Human Resource Management.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Labour Welfare Officer (LWO) position is between 27 years and 45 years. Specific age relaxations may apply as per government rules, which are detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Ordnance Factory Ambarnath LWO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website, fill it out carefully, attach necessary documents, and send it to the address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Labour Welfare Officer post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Labour Welfare Officer (LWO) post primarily involves a Personal Interview. Candidates who are shortlisted based on their applications and qualifications will be called for the interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for the Labour Welfare Officer (LWO) position at Ordnance Factory Ambarnath is contractual. This means the appointment will be for a fixed tenure as specified in the contract.

faq.question: Q9. Where is Ordnance Factory Ambarnath located?
faq.answer: Ordnance Factory Ambarnath is located in Ambarnath, Maharashtra, with the pincode 421501. Candidates applying for the LWO post will be stationed at this location.
